audio_cues.text: black friday has a clever trick it can make spending feel like saving today alex heads into the sales with a three hundred dollar budget and two very different plans one plan ends at three hundred and forty-one dollars the other ends at two hundred and sixty-three same shop same sales seventy-eight dollars apart then alex opens a shop's website a countdown clock is ticking a badge says only three left the website cheerfully announces that alex has saved one hundred and seven dollars and here's the thing alex hasn't saved one hundred and seven dollars alex is about to spend one hundred and eighty-three rule two do the math a discount isn't a saving it's just a smaller bill add the list to the cart and alex is at three hundred and forty-one dollars which is forty-one dollars over budget rule four let it sit for twenty-four hours do i need this or did the timer need me to buy it it just means the answer has to survive a night's sleep that's thirty-seven under budget and seventy-eight dollars less than the impulse cart check out the money leak audit workbook in the description
